name: Pilates & yoga studios (category guide)
summary: Reformer packages vs ClassPass sampling — instructor credentials, injury red flags, and hard-sell multi-class packs that expire unused.
body: Expat fitness threads split between boutique reformer Pilates, yoga memberships, and ClassPass hopping. Credentials matter: ask about teacher training hours and whether the studio routes injured clients to physio instead of ‘just modify’. Intro packs and large class banks commonly expire — get freeze, transfer, and refund rules in writing before the upsell desk. Reformer classes are coached differently from mat yoga; small ratios beat crowded rooms when you are learning load. Distinct from gym/PT memberships and from clinical physio. Category guide, not a ranked studio list.
whenToEngage: New to reformer — credentials / class size unclear
Large class pack expiry / freeze rules opaque
